name: f1-bmg-b173
headline: Human Written
windows: Eating a whole leaf can easily end the trip and, in my experience, may keep you from tripping for days afterward. A tiny nibble can sometimes smooth psychedelic nausea and even smooth the trip without ending it. For nausea I'd try 200mg of leaf at a time, or 10mg of the extract paste (the dried juice). But it takes only a little more than a nibble to end the trip, so I use it for nausea only when the person is okay with their trip possibly ending.

name: f1-bmg-p4p5
headline: Human Written
windows:
I've seen it work on someone else too: I once gave beach morning glory to a woman who was nauseous and miserable on a psychedelic, and within a couple of minutes she was very happy. I may have given her more than I would give now, though, since I was rushing to help her.
The trips I've seen it stop were psychedelic ones, and I don't yet have data showing that pes-caprae aborts MDMA, so for MDMA, go to MDMA: Magnesium Alarm instead.
